experiment_lock.post_result_change_rule: Preserve improvements, degradations, quiet-success flips, and preference/habit not_identifiable findings. M7.1 remediation requires a new model and experiment ID.

limitations: Preference and habit are not independently represented in frozen M6 and will be reported not_identifiable, not assigned proxy scores.
Ablation and intervention operate on a nonfresh synthetic model and do not establish real psychological causality.
Feature effects are causal only relative to the frozen computational graph, not causal claims about a human mind.
